title: Quintessential Crisp Tunisian Lentil Tagine
description: A one-pot Tunisian dish featuring ground clove and lentils, with a crispy texture from grilling, perfect for a vegan-friendly meal.
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium-high heat.
In a large bowl, whisk together the olive oil, cumin, ground clove, paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Add the chopped onion and minced garlic to the bowl and stir to combine.
Add the red lentils to the bowl and stir to coat with the spice mixture.
Transfer the lentil mixture to a large cast-iron skillet or grill-safe pot.
Pour in the vegetable broth and bring the mixture to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 20 minutes.
Remove the skillet from the heat and place it on the preheated grill.
Grill the lentil mixture for an additional 10 minutes, or until the top is crispy and golden brown.
